page_title: BRE 4-0 LOR | Brest v Lorient 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Bilal Brahimi (Brest) is adjudged offside.
87' Yellow card. Lilian Brassier (Brest) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
86' It must be a yellow card. It is. Igor Silva (Lorient) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
82' Igor Silva (Lorient) was too forceful with his tackle and Mathieu Vernice interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
79' Here comes a substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Jonas Martin.
79' That's the end of the game for Jeremy Le Douaron, who is replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
74' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Martin Satriano will be replaced by Steve Mounie (Brest).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Magnetti (Brest) comes onto the pitch for Pierre Lees-Melou.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) is brought on as a substitute for Aiyegun Tosin.
73' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) replaces Benjamin Mendy.
70' The game has begun to heat up. Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
70' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
68' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kamory Doumbia walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mahdi Camara (Brest).
60' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is substituted due to injury. Regis Le Bris gives a chance to Eli Junior Kroupi.
58' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
56' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Martin Satriano (Brest) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
54' Dangerous play by Lilian Brassier (Brest). Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Brest are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
49' The game is interrupted. Laurent Abergel (Lorient) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
47' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) makes a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' 4 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Romain Del Castillo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Kamory Doumbia (Brest), who beats Yvon Mvogo with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Romain Faivre (Lorient) horribly skewed a first-time shot from the edge of the box and sent the ball way wide of the right post.
42' The Brest players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' The substitution has been made. Julien Laporte (Lorient) has replaced Bonke Innocent.

36' Igor Silva (Lorient) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
32' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
29' 3 - 0 What a hit! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 3:0.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Martin Satriano gets to the ball, slips Kamory Doumbia (Brest) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 2:0.
23' Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight and sees a foul from Montassar Talbi (Lorient).
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Kamory Doumbia (Brest) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
22' Brest will take a free kick.
20' Martin Satriano (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Rough tackle by Kamory Doumbia (Brest). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Brest fail to score from a corner as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaps to collect the ball.
16' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Romain Faivre (Lorient) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
12' Brest keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

10' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mathieu Vernice with no other option than to blow for a foul.
7' A player from Brest commits a rough challenge. Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
5' A pass by Bradley Locko (Brest) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' The linesman signals that Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Brest will take the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
